mapper.delete: DELETE FROM chunks WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND document_version_id = #{documentVersionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chunks ( id, workspace_id, document_version_id, sequence_number, content, start_offset, end_offset, source_position ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{documentVersionId}, #{chunk.sequenceNumber}, #{chunk.content}, #{chunk.startOffset}, #{chunk.endOffset}, jsonb_build_object( 'startLine', CAST(#{chunk.startLine} AS integer), 'endLine', CAST(#{chunk.endLine} AS integer), 'startPage', CAST(#{chunk.startPage} AS integer), 'endPage', CAST(#{chunk.endPage} AS integer), 'headingPath', CAST(#{chunk.headingPath} AS text), 'chunkingVersion', CAST(#{chunkingVersion} AS text) ) )
